clips.title: The story
paras: In Malaka'jin, the scent of butchered game draws Deepmoss spiders into the trolls' camps. Xen'Zilla asks the Horde to drive the predators back from the settlement.

The trolls founded Malaka'jin as a frontier outpost in southeastern Stonetalon Mountains, where they could hunt. The craggy slopes yield plenty of game, but its meat draws nocturnal predators into camp. Deepmoss spiders are aggressive arachnids native to the crags and canyons to the north. Under cover of darkness, they slip in to scavenge the trolls' stores or hunt the hunters themselves.

Xen'Zilla asks you to track the predators north into the mountain passes, keeping Malaka'jin safe and protecting its supplies. Deepmoss Creepers and Venomspitters gather thickest around the rocky ravines and webs of Sishir Canyon. Thinning their numbers pushes the brood back from the settlement, so the hunters can rest without fearing an ambush from the shadows.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We Trolls here at Malaka'Jin have prospered from the land; Stonetalon Mountain offers great hunting for us to live on.
Lately, we have attracted the wrong dinner guests... The spiders in these mountains have been raiding our camps at night looking to steal our hunt.
If you were to help us kill off these ghastly beasts we at Malaka'Jin would be in your debt. Spiders are everywhere in Stonetalon - just head north from here and you will see what I am talking about.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hey mon, have you slain the hairy blood feeders? I fear none here in Stonetalon but I don't go walking around here at night... If you know what I mean mon!
As long as I stay off their dinner plate then all is well.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Sweet, mon! Good news, perhaps we will have fewer unwanted dinner guests tonight.
Many thanks, friend. We are forever in your debt.
